en.headline: HKUST says third medical school building tops out ahead of schedule
en.dek: The university reported that its interim Medical Education and Research Complex at Clear Water Bay topped out last week, with faculty recruitment progressing and the first 50 students targeted for 2028/29.
body: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology said on Wednesday that preparations for the city’s third medical school had entered a new stage, with the eight-storey Medical Education and Research Complex at its Clear Water Bay campus topping out last week, less than six months after groundbreaking.
President Nancy Ip said construction was proceeding according to plan. Detailed planning is under way for teaching spaces, research facilities and a simulation training centre.

Founding dean King Li said faculty recruitment had made encouraging progress, with the school aiming for at least 100 professors by 2030 to maintain a one-to-one teacher-student ratio. The curriculum and academic structure are largely in place, drawing on the university’s strengths in science, artificial intelligence and data science.

HKUST remains confident of admitting its first cohort of 50 students in the 2028/29 academic year. A permanent campus is planned in the Northern Metropolis, with the Clear Water Bay complex serving as the interim facility.

zh.headline: 科大指第三所醫學院大樓提前平頂 籌建進入新階段
zh.dek: 大學表示清水灣校園的醫學教研綜合大樓上星期平頂，師資招聘進展順利，目標2028/29學年錄取首批50名學生。
body: 香港科技大學周三表示，本港第三所醫學院的籌建工作已進入新階段，位於清水灣校園的八層高醫學教研綜合大樓上星期已經平頂，距動工不足六個月。
校長葉玉如表示，基建按計劃推進。大學正積極規劃教學空間、科研設施及模擬培訓中心等。
創院院長李競存說，師資招聘取得令人鼓舞的進展，學院目標2030年前至少有100名教授，維持一對一師生比例。課程設計及學術架構已大致成形，結合大學在理學、人工智能及數據科學的優勢。
科大有信心按計劃於2028/29學年錄取首批50名學生。永久校園計劃設於北部都會區，清水灣大樓將作臨時設施。
